core_obligations: The sheaves and the maps (proof lines 1936-1958): g_{n!}(a_n^{-1}G) has component at C_m the direct sum of copies of a_m^{-1}G indexed by varphi : [n] -> [m]; the differential d^n_i : g_{n!}(a_n^{-1}G) -> g_{n-1!}(a_{n-1}^{-1}G) is the adjoint of the insertion of a_n^{-1}G into the coproduct g_n^{-1}g_{n-1!}(a_{n-1}^{-1}G) labeled by delta^n_i, and the map to a^{-1}G is adjoint to the identity of a_0^{-1}G (using a_0^{-1}G = (a^{-1}G)_0).

Evaluation on components (lines 1960-1985): g_m^{-1} of the complex in degrees ..., 2, 1, 0 is the direct sums of a_m^{-1}G over Mor_Delta([k], [m]), i.e., a_m^{-1}G tensor the Z-complex of the simplicial-resolution-Z lemma; that complex is homotopy equivalent to Z in degree 0 (proven there), and tensoring with a_m^{-1}G preserves the quasi-isomorphism, so the complex is exact with cokernel a^{-1}G in degree 0 on every component, proving exactness on C_total.
proof_roadmap: Define the terms via the component shriek formula and the maps by adjunction from the coface labels.
Apply g_m^{-1} componentwise and identify the result as a_m^{-1}G tensor the Z-resolution complex.
Conclude exactness from the established homotopy equivalence of the Z-complex.
difficulty_reason: Resolution lemma (statement 1928-1943, proof 1945-1985): the a^{-1}G analogue of the chapter's Z-resolution - the complex and its maps are defined explicitly through the adjunctions, and exactness is proven componentwise by reduction to the already-established homotopy equivalence of the Z-complex; no verification is omitted. H2: short structural reduction over the Z-resolution.
